teach.motesart_intro: Before you touch a single key, you need to know the pattern. Every major scale — no matter what key — follows the same rule.
teach.core_concept: The major scale pattern is: Whole - Whole - Half - Whole - Whole - Whole - Half
teach.motesart_shorthand: Think of it this way: there is no note between 3 and 4, and no note between 7 and 8. Every other number has a note between it.
key_facts: The major scale has 8 notes, numbered 1 through 8.
The distance between most notes is a Whole step — one note exists between them.
The distance between 3 and 4 is a Half step — no note exists between them.
The distance between 7 and 8 is a Half step — no note exists between them.
This pattern is the same in every major key. The numbers always work the same way.

motesart_language.pattern_spoken: Whole, Whole, Half, Whole, Whole, Whole, Half
motesart_language.half_step_rule: No note between 3 and 4. No note between 7 and 8.
motesart_language.whole_step_rule: Every other pair has one note between them.

proof.description: Student must demonstrate recall, not just exposure. All questions must be answered correctly to pass Gate 0.

questions.prompt: Say the major scale pattern from the beginning.
acceptable_answers: whole whole half whole whole whole half
w w h w w w h
questions.motesart_correct: That's it. Whole, Whole, Half, Whole, Whole, Whole, Half. Lock that in.
questions.motesart_wrong: Not quite. Remember — most steps are Whole, but 3 to 4 and 7 to 8 are Half. Try again.

questions.prompt: Between which two numbers is there NO note?
questions.motesart_correct: Yes. 3 to 4 — no note between them. That is a half step.
questions.motesart_wrong: Oof. Let's back up. Where does the pattern get tight? 3 and 4 — no note between them.

questions.prompt: Where is the second half step in the major scale?
questions.motesart_correct: Locked. 7 to 8 — that's the second tight spot.
questions.motesart_wrong: Not even close — kidding, you were close. It's 7 to 8. No note between them.

questions.prompt: Between 1 and 2 — is that a whole step or half step?
questions.motesart_correct: Correct. There is a note between 1 and 2. Whole step.
questions.motesart_wrong: 1 to 2 has a note between them — that makes it a Whole step. Half steps have nothing in between.

questions.prompt: Fill in the missing steps: W - W - ? - W - W - W - ?
questions.motesart_correct: Yes. H and H. The half steps sit at 3-4 and 7-8. Every time.
questions.motesart_wrong: Those are the two tight spots. Both should be H — for Half step.

acceptable_answers: half whole whole whole half whole whole
h w w w h w w
questions.motesart_correct: You had it. Even backward you know where the half steps live.
questions.motesart_wrong: Backward it starts with a Half — because going down, 8 to 7 is a half step. Try again from 8.

questions.prompt: In your own words — why does the major scale have half steps at 3-4 and 7-8?
questions.motesart_correct: That is ownership. You are not just remembering it — you understand it.
questions.motesart_wrong: Try to explain it in your own words. Why is 3 to 4 a half step? What makes it different from 1 to 2?

categories.description: Student places half steps at wrong positions
categories.trigger: answers 1-2, 2-3, 4-5, 5-6, or 6-7 as the half step
categories.next_action: re-teach half step definition, then re-quiz G0_Q2 and G0_Q3

categories.description: Student reverses whole and half step definitions
categories.trigger: calls half step the larger distance
categories.next_action: trigger WYL auditory intervention — play W vs H example

categories.trigger: omits second half step or stops at H W W W
categories.next_action: trigger visual intervention — show full W-W-H-W-W-W-H map

categories.description: Student refers to C-D-E-F rather than 1-2-3-4
categories.trigger: uses letter names instead of Motesart numbers in any answer
categories.next_action: Motesart reminds: 'We use numbers, not letters. In this system, F is 4 — not F.'

categories.description: Student recites pattern but fails ownership question G0_Q7
categories.trigger: passes Q1-Q6 but cannot explain why in own words
categories.next_action: flag as execution_only — ownership gate not passed — require G0_Q7 retry or teacher review

wyl_interventions.description: WYL triggers AFTER a mistake is detected. Not from student label. From the specific failure.

visual.content: Display W-W-H-W-W-W-H step diagram with color coding. Whole steps = wide bar. Half steps = narrow bar highlighted teal. Numbers 1-8 labeled below each step.
visual.interaction: Student taps each step to hear the label spoken by Motesart.

auditory.content: Play two audio examples back to back: (1) whole step interval, (2) half step interval. Motesart says: 'Hear the difference? The half step is tight — almost no space. The whole step has room.' Then re-quiz.
auditory.interaction: Student selects which sound they just heard.

kinesthetic.content: Student taps on-screen buttons labeled BIG and SMALL for each step of the scale in order. BIG = whole step, SMALL = half step. Motesart confirms each tap.
kinesthetic.interaction: Tap sequence: BIG-BIG-SMALL-BIG-BIG-BIG-SMALL. Motesart confirms each.

readwrite.content: Student fills in blanks: W - W - ? - W - W - W - ?. Then writes or selects: 'The half steps in the major scale are between ___ and ___, and between ___ and ___.'

mastery_rule.execution_definition: Student answers G0_Q1 through G0_Q6 with score >= 0.85
mastery_rule.ownership_definition: Student passes G0_Q7 — explains the pattern in own words, not recited
mastery_rule.ownership_question: In your own words — why does the major scale have half steps at 3-4 and 7-8?

not_ready.motesart_response: Let's back up. We need more time here before we move on.

developing.motesart_response: You are getting there. Let's try that again.

almost_owned.motesart_response: You almost had it. One more pass and it will stick.

mastered.motesart_response: That is locked. You know where the half steps live.

homework_reinforcement.description: Five Find-A-Note variant games that reinforce Gate 0 through retrieval practice.

games.prompt: Which two numbers have no note between them?
Fill in the major scale pattern: W - W - ? - W - W - W - ?
Between numbers 2 and 3 — whole step or half step?
Say the pattern going down from 8.
games.correct: H W W W H W W

games.prompt: Why is 3 to 4 a half step and not a whole step?
